visualReviewMethod: Actually opened and visually inspected eight extracted chapter midpoint PNGs with view_image, at 6, 18, 30, 42, 54, 66, 78 and 90 seconds. Entire video stream separately decoded with ffmpeg -xerror; full continuous motion playback was not visually reviewed by this reviewer.

visualReviewFrames.title: Bundled tubes, Chicago
visualReviewFrames.notes: Whole tower and antennas fit; mapped offices create plausible foreground depth. Night panes and sky remain readable.

visualReviewFrames.title: Inside Catalog
visualReviewFrames.notes: Interior skylight, mezzanine and reflective floor are visible with localized warm and cool lighting. Minor glossy-floor grain.

visualReviewFrames.title: Black aluminum, bronze glass
visualReviewFrames.notes: Close facade mullions, panels and individual fasteners remain clear with readable night material detail.

visualReviewFrames.title: A garden above the city
visualReviewFrames.notes: Rooftop furniture, curved Catalog skylight, paths and planting are legible under localized lamps.

visualReviewFrames.title: Inside the Skydeck
visualReviewFrames.notes: Observation glazing, structural mullions and glass Ledge boxes frame the illuminated city and lake horizon; dim interior flooring remains visible.

visualReviewFrames.title: Out on the Ledge
visualReviewFrames.notes: Downward view through glass shows transmission and reflected city windows; the street and river network remain readable below.

visualReviewFrames.title: Crown of the skyline
visualReviewFrames.notes: Close illuminated broadcast mast shows bands, support members and red marker lights against clean sky, with the night skyline below.

visualReviewFrames.title: Along the Chicago River
visualReviewFrames.notes: Open river corridor clearly shows the illuminated tour boat, mapped bridge, bridge houses, banks and rippled reflections. Fine grain remains in dark water and glossy surfaces.

limitations: 24 samples per pixel leaves some fine sampling grain in dark water, reflections and glossy interior surfaces. This report does not claim zero noise or independently quantify temporal behavior.
